description: Every experiment behind a reported table or figure, the code that executes it, the command, its configurations, the artifacts it produces (artifact identifiers of release/paper_artifacts.json) and the displays it supports. not_executable names a part of a reported experiment that the released code cannot execute, with the reason. scripts/statement_check.py verifies that every listed file exists, that every artifact a display needs has a producing experiment, and reports every not_executable part.

experiments.title: Eight-stage lifecycle of every dataset: prepare, train, explore, fit, select, confirm, admit, evaluate; separated data roles (E10), selection trace (E15), uncertainty hierarchy (E16), per-cell support (E19), Full/Lean profiles (E20)
experiments.command: bash run_cross_morse.sh reproduce   (one dataset: python -B run_cross_morse_<dataset>.py --profile full --device cuda)

experiments.title: Budget-matched comparison arms at the common ceiling: initial-input schedule predictor, distillation, no-observation replanning, selective sensing
experiments.command: python -B scripts/arm_campaign.py execute --manifest <campaign.json>; python -B scripts/export_records.py budget-matched

experiments.title: Nine-test mechanism confirmation family with joint Holm correction
experiments.command: python -B scripts/audit_s14_confirmation.py <campaign>

experiments.title: Retraining-allowed external baselines under the shared 48-trial HPO ceiling
experiments.command: python -B scripts/run_upstream_baseline.py --plan <baseline-plan.json> --output <study> --phase hpo|select|final

experiments.title: Timing protocol and scheduler accounting
experiments.command: python -B scripts/export_records.py from-runs | baselines

experiments.title: GPU execution environment of the reported runs
experiments.command: bash environment/arrhenius/capture_environment.sh <python> <directory>

experiments.title: Attribution of inserted-site transport: native-only and all-site arms of q_C and the confirmed feedback route at the same members and units
experiments.command: python -B scripts/run_experiment.py inserted-site plan --parent <pascalvoc_sp run> --parent <coco_sp run> --parent <peptides_func run> --output <dir>; ... inserted-site run --output <dir> --device cuda --trust-local-checkpoints; ... inserted-site export --output <dir>

experiments.title: Comparator on the extended ensemble grid E = 1, 2, 4, 8, 12, 16, 20 with distinct checkpoints and paired seeds
experiments.command: python -B scripts/run_experiment.py ensemble-grid plan --parent <run or Roman campaign> (each admitted dataset) --output <dir>; ... ensemble-grid run --output <dir> [--job K] --device cuda --trust-local-checkpoints; ... ensemble-grid export --output <dir>

experiments.title: Frozen substitute backbones behind the same adapter (GCNII on arxiv and Roman-empire, linear GINE on PascalVOC-SP) against the paper's plants
experiments.command: python -B scripts/run_experiment.py cross-backbone plan --parent <arxiv run> --parent <Roman campaign> --parent <pascalvoc_sp run> --output <dir>; ... cross-backbone run --output <dir> --data-root <data> --device cuda; ... cross-backbone export --output <dir>

experiments.title: Equal-budget 2^3 component factorials: ogbn-arxiv (A, O, X) and PascalVOC-SP (S, O, X)
experiments.command: python -B scripts/run_experiment.py factorial plan --parent <arxiv run> --parent <pascalvoc_sp run> --output <dir> [--switches <table.json>]; ... factorial run --output <dir> --device cuda --trust-local-checkpoints; ... factorial export --output <dir>

not_executable.reason: a cell controller fitted separately at equal budget (observer factor O) needs a controller fit the released runtime does not provide; the runner applies the factors as run-time switches on the parent's fitted controllers

experiments.title: Registered sensitivity grids of the support thresholds, selection margin, equivalence margin and clip level
experiments.command: python -B scripts/run_sweep.py plan --sweep sensitivity_grids --parent <run> ... --output <dir>; ... run --plan <dir>/plan.json --data-root <data> --device cuda; ... collect --plan <dir>/plan.json; python -B scripts/export_sweep_records.py --results <dir>/results.json --hardware ... --period ...

experiments.title: MPC-RH horizon and beam-width sweep: selection effect and expected cost per configuration on D_select
experiments.command: python -B scripts/run_sweep.py plan --sweep horizon_beam_sweep --parent <pascalvoc_sp run> --output <dir>; ... run --plan <dir>/plan.json --data-root <data> --device cuda; ... collect --plan <dir>/plan.json; python -B scripts/export_sweep_records.py --results <dir>/results.json --hardware ... --period ...

experiments.title: Module-specific evaluation and ablation signatures
experiments.command: python -B scripts/run_sweep.py plan --sweep module_ablations --parent <run> ... --output <dir>; ... collect --plan <dir>/plan.json; python -B scripts/export_sweep_records.py --results <dir>/results.json --hardware ... --period ...

not_executable.reason: seven of the ten module comparisons (spectral bands, source alignment, confidence sensors, transport history, observer variants, recovery type, comparator branch) have no switch in the released runtime; the runner measures the Full/Lean profile, radius-uncertainty and sequence-risk rows from the sealed contrasts

experiments.title: Dependence sensitivity of descriptive admission to the cluster buffer (2 to 32 hops)
experiments.command: python -B scripts/run_sweep.py plan --sweep buffer_sensitivity --parent <arxiv run> --parent <proteins run> --output <dir>

not_executable.reason: the released runtime records the k-hop buffer as a context diagnostic and resamples the METIS or degree-stratified cores, so the buffer changes no admission statistic; the paper does not define how the buffer enters the resampling units

experiments.title: Sequence predictability: initial-input predictor of the feedback policy's executed sequences fitted on D_explore, evaluated on D_compare (phi_seq, phi_gain)
experiments.command: python -B scripts/run_experiment_b.py predictability plan --parent <run> --output <dir>; ... predictability run --plan <dir>/plan.json --device cuda --trust-local-checkpoints; ... predictability export --results <dir> --hardware <hw> --period <period>

experiments.title: Search versus model error: exact enumeration at H <= 4 against the registered beam (2 e_H and zeta_H of main Proposition 8)
experiments.command: python -B scripts/run_experiment_b.py search-enumeration plan --parent <run> --output <dir> [--planner mpc_rh|mpc_ol]; ... search-enumeration run --plan <dir>/plan.json --device cuda --trust-local-checkpoints; ... search-enumeration export --results <dir> --hardware <hw> --period <period>

experiments.title: Graph-irrelevant, misleading-graph, sensor-bias and support-shift constructions behind the static input gate
experiments.command: python -B scripts/run_experiment_b.py negative-controls plan --parent <run> --output <dir>; ... negative-controls run --plan <dir>/plan.json --device cuda --trust-local-checkpoints; ... negative-controls export --results <dir> --hardware <hw> --period <period>

experiments.title: Serving-time input gate g_input: fallback probability, deployed latency and memory, false-safe and harm-miss rates
experiments.command: python -B scripts/run_experiment_b.py input-gate plan --parent <run> --output <dir>; ... input-gate run --plan <dir>/plan.json --device cuda --trust-local-checkpoints; ... input-gate export --results <dir> --hardware <hw> --period <period>

experiments.title: Spectral displacement audit of main Proposition 6 and tightness of the band-limited bound (6.1)
experiments.command: python -B scripts/run_experiment_b.py band-audit plan --parent <run sealed through explore> --output <dir>; ... band-audit run --plan <dir>/plan.json --device cuda --trust-local-checkpoints; ... band-audit export --results <dir> --hardware <hw> --period <period>; ... band-audit export-tightness --results <dir> --dataset <dataset> --baseline shared --hardware <hw> --period <period>

not_executable.reason: policy value over matched confidence/history controls needs a controller fitted without the spectral coordinates; the released runtime has no switch for it (as for E7, E8)

experiments.title: Runtime and peak memory of the deployed rule against processed graph size: full benchmark graphs, breadth-first subgraphs and collection test graphs timed with the E17 TimingSession inside completed GPU allocations
experiments.command: python -B scripts/run_timing_records.py scaling plan --parent <run or Roman campaign> (each dataset) --output <dir>; ... scaling run --output <dir> [--job K] --device cuda --trust-local-checkpoints; bash hpc/capture_arrhenius_accounting.sh <job ids> <acct>; ... scaling export --output <dir> --accounting <acct>/sacct_original.psv

experiments.title: Throughput and training-time anchors that bracket the per-input nominal execution time of Definition 2
experiments.command: python -B scripts/run_timing_records.py anchors plan --parent <run or Roman campaign> (each admitted dataset) --output <dir> --scaling-output <E17 scaling dir> [--accounting <sacct export> --job-map <job map>]; ... anchors run --output <dir>; ... anchors export --output <dir>

experiments.title: Official test scores of the comparator ensemble grid recomputed from the saved member predictions
experiments.command: python -B scripts/run_timing_records.py grid-scores export --grid-output <scripts/run_experiment.py ensemble-grid output>

experiments.title: Paired D_confirm contrasts (conditional state destruction minus intact; MPC-RH minus MPC-OL) of each dataset's strongest feedback configuration for the Figure 3a-b cells that neither the joint S14 family nor the deployed rule's confirmation record supplies
experiments.command: python -B scripts/run_confirmation_analysis.py mechanism plan --parent <run|Roman campaign> ... --output <dir>; ... mechanism run --output <dir> --job K --device cuda --trust-local-checkpoints; ... mechanism export --output <dir>

experiments.title: Per-input oracle enumerated on D_admit after every decision is fixed: depth prefixes of the executed sequences of the registered resource-feasible configurations at the comparator's ensemble size; oracle-depth quartiles and disagreement with q_C
experiments.command: python -B scripts/run_confirmation_analysis.py oracle plan --parent <run|Roman campaign> ... --output <dir>; ... oracle run --output <dir> --job K --device cuda --trust-local-checkpoints; ... oracle export --output <dir>
